The running app already used the approved In bloom logo. Its four colored petals and yellow center were verified in the live sidebar before every capture. Screenshots were taken directly through Playwright with no DOM substitutions or image edits.

The capture instance used the separate local PostgreSQL database clara_website_screenshots, with background queues disabled. A normal demo-account login and a dedicated fictional Fieldnotes workspace were used. Only fictional brand settings were saved; no generation or publishing was run. Existing application source was not modified for this capture.

Temporary capture scripts and browser sessions are not included in the website. These images contain only demo workspace information.
